# F is defined and form type is a struct

muxt generate --use-receiver-type=T
muxt check

muxt check --verbose
cmpenv stderr want-check.txt

muxt check -v
cmpenv stderr want-check.txt

exec go build -o build

-- want-check.txt --
checking endpoint GET / F(form)
OK
-- in.go --
package main

type (
	T  struct{}
	In struct {
		field string
	}
)

func (T) F(form In) int { return 0 }

func main() {}
